title: Live Performance Federal Insurance Guarantee Fund Bill 2021
short_title: Live Performance Federal Insurance Guarantee Fund Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would create a government-backed insurance fund for live performances affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
The Treasurer would be required to set up the fund through a legislative instrument within 30 days of the law starting.
The fund would start on the later of the day after royal assent or when money is appropriated from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
changes: Establishes the Live Performance Federal Insurance Guarantee Fund.
Requires the Treasurer to make rules for the fund's establishment, governance and operation.
Provides that the fund will underwrite insurance for the live performance industry.
summary.affected: The live performance industry and organisers of live events.
